remaining_defects: Magenta/purple speckle clusters remain on the rump (thigh), lower tail base and tail tip, plus a purple tint on the muzzle/lip. They read as dark brown blotches over grey.
Pale teal/cyan fringe halo on tail edge, mane tips and lower legs (over dark grey it reads as a glow outline).
ko-cutouts-r3.fix: Despill again with a hue-targeted pass, not only an edge clamp. Select pixels with hue 270-340 deg and saturation > 0.2 anywhere in the opaque area (not only the edge band), and rotate their hue to the neighbouring body teal (about 195-205 deg) or desaturate and match luminance. Then erode alpha 1-2 px with a 1 px feather on tail, mane and leg edges, and clamp edge-pixel colour to the local interior median to remove the pale teal halo. Re-check over purple, dark grey and a mid-grey/green plate. Pose, anatomy and full-body framing are fine; do not regenerate.
